evidence.title: Privnote - Send notes that will self-destruct after being read

name: Privnote
summary: Free web service that turns a note into a self-destructing, optionally password-protected link.
description: Privnote encrypts your note in the browser and gives you a link to share; the note self-destructs after the recipient reads it once. Options include a manual password, an expiration date and an email notification when the note is destroyed. No password or user registration is required.
contains: expiration date and destruction email notification
no registration; note is encrypted in the browser
link shared by email or instant message
